A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-3.80037,51.59922.name: Wales Fertility Institute – Neath
-3.80037,51.59922.state: Neath Port Talbot Hospital, Baglan Way, Port Talbot, SA12 7BX
-3.80037,51.59922.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

112.19300,31.04352.name: 荆门市人民医院
112.19300,31.04352.state: 湖北省（33家） — 湖北省荆门市象山大道39号
112.19300,31.04352.desc: A medical institution approved by China's National Health Commission to perform assisted reproduction. Approved for: ICSI — a single sperm injected into the egg; IVF with embryo transfer; insemination with the partner's sperm. All of its approvals are in formal operation. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Approval is compulsory in China and performing assisted reproduction without it is unlawful, so this list is a register rather than a directory of members. It names every approved institution in the country, which is more than almost any other state publishes.

-79.40231,43.66656.name: University of Toronto
-79.40231,43.66656.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, February 2025
-79.40231,43.66656.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, February 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

24.91100,60.18700.name: FinnGen
24.91100,60.18700.state: Helsinki — Institute for Molecular Medicine, Tukholmankatu 8
24.91100,60.18700.desc: Links genetic data from around half a million Finns to a national health register going back decades, in a partnership between Finnish universities and a group of pharmaceutical companies. Finland's population history makes rare variants unusually common there, so the country is scientifically valuable in a way that created the arrangement rather than the other way round.

-77.00900,38.88950.name: Regulations.gov — filing a comment and reading the response
-77.00900,38.88950.desc: The portal where a US comment is actually submitted, and where every other comment on the same docket can be read. That second part is the useful one: the agency’s response to comments is published here, so it is possible to see whether a point landed and how it was answered. Cite the docket number in the first line.

6.13200,49.61100.name: Beekeepers — the Bablok ruling and pollen in honey
6.13200,49.61100.state: Luxembourg — Court of Justice of the European Union
6.13200,49.61100.desc: A Bavarian beekeeper found engineered maize pollen in his honey from a trial planted several kilometres away, and in 2011 the European Court of Justice held that the honey could not be sold without authorisation covering it. It is the clearest legal recognition anywhere that a person can be harmed by a release on land they neither own nor farm. Beekeepers consequently have standing in consultations that neighbours often lack, and a hive is also a sampling device: pollen collected from a colony records what was flowering within a few kilometres, which no single field visit can.

-47.06080,-22.90560.name: Instituto Agronômico de Campinas (IAC)
-47.06080,-22.90560.desc: One of the oldest agricultural research institutes in the Americas, run by the state of São Paulo, breeding cultivars and running the trials that establish how a genotype behaves under local pathogens and pests — including collaborative work with the producer-funded cotton institute in Mato Grosso on a virus affecting the crop. It matters to this map because Brazil's field research capacity is split three ways: a federal corporation, state institutes like this one, and grower-funded foundations, with the multinationals' own trials on top. A reader trying to find who tested a variety before it reached the market has four different kinds of answer to check, and only one of them is the company that sells it.
